question: Compare the 2025 average completed order value of Enterprise and SMB customers. If Enterprise's is more than 20% higher than SMB's, break down Enterprise's 2025 completed revenue by product category; otherwise, break down SMB's 2025 completed revenue by product category.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH segment_aov AS (SELECT c.segment, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1.0 - oi.discount)) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS aov FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND c.segment IN ('Enterprise', 'SMB') GROUP BY c.segment), chosen_segment AS (SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'Enterprise' THEN aov END) > 1.20 * MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SMB' THEN aov END) THEN 'Enterprise' ELSE 'SMB' END AS segment FROM segment_aov) SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1.0 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN chosen_segment AS cs ON c.segment = cs.segment WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 500
